purpose: paired local feasibility diagnostic at every exact V7b stopped origin

proposal.objective: same original current-panel risk, old_weight and current_dispersion plus original quadratic effort; no predicted old hard constraints
proposal.original_relinearizations: retained as origin metadata only; no V8 relinearization or actual-risk backtracking
proposal.reuse: one exact generated action array shared by both filter calls; never regenerate separately

physical_constraints.retention: each of four original warmup old-panel losses at every prospective accepted update
physical_constraints.adoption: entire original H1 or H8 sequence certified atomically; failed prefix remains unadopted
physical_constraints.original_stopped_controllers: remain stopped; these are independent diagnostic continuations, not resumed original runs

bounded_search_difference.single_ray_v7: original maximum16 panel batches per step
bounded_search_difference.joint_actual_old_v8: maximum64 unique search batches including intended seed plus at most1 selected replay batch per step
bounded_search_difference.interpretation: algorithms and fixed search budgets differ; report actual queries/CPU and do not attribute any improvement solely to search geometry

order: origin manifest order, alternating filter order by ordinal modulo2

measurement.old_queries: transparent loss_gradients observer matches exact normalized old-panel input identities; record all losses/gradient hashes and unique parameter vectors
measurement.optimizer_calls: transparent advance observer records all prospective before/after complete state vectors, metadata, interventions and receipts, including failed branches
measurement.observer: returns original results unchanged; restore class methods in finally; overflow or observation error fails integrity
measurement.cpu: whole actual proposal and each filter separately, including observation overhead; independent replay and serialization excluded from controller comparison and included in total run
measurement.shared_proposal_cost: charge once per counterfactual proposal-plus-filter pipeline; do not double-count in actual whole-run total
measurement.independent_replay: every recorded old-panel value/gradient and every actual prospective optimizer transition, plus every returned accepted state/receipt and four zero-slack constraints

failure_handling: all98origins and196filter slots retained; proposal/input/error slots unavailable rather than substituted; bounded rejection/unresolved is not global infeasibility
output: compact compressed arrays and gzip query/trial records per slot; explicit cases, report and complete final seal; no duplicate feature caches
source_freeze_required: separate remotely_published=true freeze JSON binds protocol_sha256, source_commit and exact source_hashes before any real-origin proposal/filter call

runtime.historical_v7_runtime: thread setting not registered; remains unknown and is not retroactively declared single-thread
